options: A woman is talking on the phone at her desk.
A woman is typing a report on her laptop.
A woman is drinking coffee from a mug.
A woman is reading a notebook.
explanation_zh: 女子坐在辦公桌前，一手拿著手機講電話，一手放在筆電上，故 (A) 正確；她並非在打字、喝咖啡或看筆記本，故其餘選項錯誤。

options: A man is signing a contract.
A man is presenting ideas on a whiteboard.
A man is answering the phone.
A man is watering a plant.
explanation_zh: 男子站在白板前，一邊在板上書寫一邊向同事解說構想，故 (B) 正確；他並未簽約、講電話或澆花，故其餘選項錯誤。

photo_credit: Photo by Vitaly Gariev on Unsplash
options: The colleagues are having lunch together.
A woman is presenting a chart to her colleagues.
A woman is signing a document.
The colleagues are shaking hands.
explanation_zh: 女子站在螢幕旁，向坐著的同事簡報螢幕上的銷售圖表，故 (B) 正確；圖中沒有用餐、簽署文件或握手的動作。

photo_credit: Photo by Vitaly Gariev on Unsplash
options: They are shaking hands across the table.
They are signing a contract together.
They are drinking coffee together.
They are arguing with each other.
explanation_zh: 兩人隔著桌子伸出手互相握手，故 (A) 正確；桌上雖放著文件夾，但他們並未簽名、喝咖啡或爭吵。
